name: Undubbed Goes Rogue
long_description:
Join UNDUBBED at The Rogue and Vagabond as they play their favourite deep cuts from jazz, hip-hop, fusion and beyond. With many years of improvisational experience as a group, UNDUBBED is sure to take you on a journey from introspective soundscapes to chaotic interplay.

UNDUBBED is made up of some familiar faces:

Ciaran Egan - Drums
Alex Cooper - Bass
Join them for a memorable night at the Rogue and Vagabond, where deep grooves meet cinematic soundscapes.

Music from 9:30pm, FREE Entry (Koha encouraged)

id: The Racket Lounge-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The Racket Lounge
long_description:
Grab a spot on our couch and enjoy the noise at The Racket Lounge - a chill classical music series showcasing up-and-coming Pōneke musicians.

If you’ve never been to a classical concert before, or if you have and now you want to see talented emerging musicians experimenting and playing what they want to play, then The Racket Lounge is for you. Over the past two seasons we’ve seen classical covers, jazz ensembles, video game soundtracks, original compositions, loop pedals, poetry and much more. Our 2026 season is shaping up to be just as epic, plus with your tickets starting at just $5 you can afford to take a chance on something new.

Each concert will feature a different line up of musicians and genres, to be announced a week before each session. If you’re a musician looking to perform at The Racket Lounge, then head to the New Zealand String Quartet’s website to see how to apply.



The Racket Lounge is created and presented by the New Zealand String Quartet Trust - Te Rōpū Tūrū o Aotearoa, New Zealand’s longest-running professional string quartet. With support from Wellington City Council.

Tickets are choose your price starting from just $5.

Please note that Bedlam & Squalor is a licensed venue, so under 18s must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. Everyone must bring ID.

name: Street Beat
long_description:
FAM whānau & friends are in FULL EFFECT, celebrating the rich tapestry that is ‘street’ music, nodding our keen heads to the influence Hip Hop, and its far reaching, DIY community mindset, has had on our ability to approach music, express, create, connect, innovate, refine, invigorate, remix, dance, shake it down, and do it up super niiiiiiiiiice.

From Boom Bap to Backpack, Westcoast, Electro, New school, Underground, Bruk, Broken beat, 90s, 80’s, Golden Era, Ragga, Go-go, Freestyle, Grime, Street Soul, Baltimore, Ghettotech, Hyphy, Baile Funk, Footwork, Chopped, Screwed, Memphis, Bounce, Boogie, Bass, Aotearoa, UK, Dancehall, Breakbeat, it's like dat, and it don't stop!

Stupid dope lineup including Awa, Mikki D, Tony Douglas, DFresh, Mūsh, Maximilian, Kerb, Uncle Silverback, Cassawarrior, Campbell Ngata, G Major and friends, spinning across the board, street beat music for the party people dem.

All of that to really just say, let’s have a party!

id: Te Kōkī Big Band Presents: You Can Count On Ella!-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Te Kōkī Big Band Presents: You Can Count On Ella!
long_description:
Te Kōkī NZSM Big Band One will be performing songs from the 1963 album Ella and Basie! as well as other selections from the wider catalogues of both Ella Fitzgerald and the Count Basie Orchestra, two of the most important figures of the style.

This programme will be artfully presented by featured student vocalists Izi Dawson and Georgia Doyne, and instrumentalists from NZSM's jazz school led by Seth Boy.

They will be supported on the night by NZSM's vocal ensemble led by artist teacher Iris Little.

Music from 8pm, FREE ENTRY - Koha for the band encouraged!
